description:
v1.0 | 18 gates | 8 ticks
https://github.com/byggmesterPRO/pareto-circuits

Turns a hex digit (0-9, A-F) into the seven segments of a display.

Use this in a creation that shows one digit on a display, such as a counter or a calculator readout. It takes hexadecimal digits, so the display can also show A to F.

Connect the digit to the input gates, least significant bit first. Each output gate drives one segment, in the order a to g: a is the top bar, b the upper right, c the lower right, d the bottom, e the lower left, f the upper left and g the middle bar.

Inputs (yellow gates, first row, lowest bit first): the digit = x 0-3.
Outputs (green gates): segments a to g = x 0-6 (a top, then clockwise, g middle).

Profile: small, the build with the fewest gates for this size.
How it works: Found by computer search for the fewest gates.
Checked on every possible input in a simulator. Gates include the input gates; ticks count the input gate too.
By: byggmesterPRO
